name: Miyamura Sakura
source:
Founder and administrator of Mama Club. She has been instrumental in keeping information about the club confidential and running smoothly.

She sometimes participates in the activities herself and is enthusiastic about putting her philosophy into practice.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
